item.text: {"tool":"baseline_summary","argument":"","why":"Measure melody and chord failures on the pilot and full development set so the intervention targets an observed problem.","hypothesis":"The baseline has distinct melody and chord failure patterns that can guide selection between image preprocessing, chord extraction and vision transcription.","expected_observation":"Separate melody and chord error measurements, with pilot-to-full-set comparisons; uniformly distributed errors would weaken the case for a narrowly targeted intervention.","evidence_ids":["goal","dataset"]}
